title: Product list
summary: Current product codes, names and categories for Valdena Gelato Shop. Contains 64 products covering the post-2024 code system. This is a static reference table that lists only current (post-2024) codes — codes ending in 'L' that were used before 2024-04-01 are not present. The table is refreshed on change and was last updated on 2025-03-31. It serves as the key to decode product_code in sales.daily_by_product for the period after 2024-04-01, but cannot directly map pre-2024 codes because no mapping table exists.

spatial.notes: The Valdena Gelato Shop is a single shop in northern Italy; no geographic codes appear in this table.

quality_notes: No mapping table exists between old (pre-2024) and new (post-2024) product codes. Old codes ending in 'L' cannot be decoded via this table.
Matching old and new codes must be attempted via product name, but the wiki warns that some names are not unique.
This table was last refreshed on 2025-03-31. It may not reflect product changes after that date.

The catalog description says 'Current product codes, names and categories' — the wiki (product_codes_2024, last edited 2024-04-02) is more specific: it confirms only current (post-2024) codes are listed.
